title: WorkItem
description: Durable dependency, lease, retry, and artifact contract for delegated work.

state.description: Control-plane work-item state id. The 8-value lifecycle vocabulary (submitted, ready, leased, running, succeeded, failed, cancelled, dead_letter) is enforced at runtime by the native WorkItem state machine (WORK_ITEM_DEF in the engine; WORK_ITEM_STATES in agent_utilities.knowledge_graph.core.work_durability), not pinned as a closed wire enum (W2.5 statechart migration, reports/w2_5-statechart-migration-design.md section 2.5).

lease_holder_id.description: Opaque worker identity; never a personal display name.

lane_intent.description: RMDD-28 immutable development-lane allocation intent. Present only on lane.lifecycle/lane.cleanup WorkItems; absent (null) for every other kind. This is the sole typed carrier for lane intent -- it must never be smuggled through consent, preferred_target, or correlation_id.
